title: Rise of the Triad - Run Like Smeg
description:
"Run Like Smeg" from the game Rise of the Triad: Dark War (1995) from 3D Realms. Composed by Lee Jackson.

An early FPS with some great music, it took me a couple of tries to pick a song from it that fit in the channel limit, but I'm quite happy with how this one turned out.
